visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera captures a wide view of a calm ocean under a bright, cloud-filled sky. A wooden railing of a walkway is visible in the foreground, creating a leading line towards the horizon where distant hills are faintly seen. (2) Indoors, a young woman with a headband, dressed in a traditional pink and white Hanbok, sits gracefully. Behind her is a traditional folding screen with calligraphy and landscape paintings, under soft, warm indoor lighting. (3) A close-up shot focuses on a person's hands holding two brown hard-boiled eggs, striking them together. The background is a dimly lit, cozy indoor space characteristic of a Korean jjimjilbang sauna. (4) The scene shifts to a service counter where a 'VISIT BUSAN PASS' sign is displayed. A hand holds a promotional flyer showing various Hanbok styles and prices, indicating a travel pass benefit. (5) A white document listing numerous attractions under 'PURPLE Group A' and 'BLUE Group B' is shown. The list is detailed and organized in a table format, likely part of the pass information. (6) Graphic overlays illustrate the different Visit Busan Pass options, including 24-hour and 48-hour 'Time-limited' types and 'BIG 3' or 'BIG 5' 'Quantity-limited' types with color-coded icons. (7) A vibrant blue and white tourist train, labeled as the Haeundae Coastal Train, pulls into a sunlit station. Inside, passengers are seen waving and looking out the large windows at the passing sea view. (8) High-altitude shots show the vast expanse of Haeundae Beach with its turquoise water and sandy shore. A woman in a white sweater looks through a large glass window at the X the SKY observation deck. (9) The exterior of 'HAEON HANBOK' shop features mannequins in traditional attire. Inside, racks are filled with hundreds of colorful Hanboks. The woman from before poses outdoors near a traditional wall with lanterns. (10) At the Running Man center, bright yellow walls and interactive game kiosks are shown. A person puts on a red R-wristband and engages in games like shooting, basketball, and stationary cycling to earn points. (11) The entrance to Spa Land is shown with a green plant wall. The interior features large, modern sauna domes and a dining area where visitors in uniform sit at tables eating ramen and snacks. (12) A person holds several Spa Land tickets. They then use a smartphone to scan a QR code at a digital check-in kiosk, demonstrating the ease of using the digital travel pass. (13) A woman walks up a wide glass staircase in a modern hall. Above her, a large art installation made of shimmering glass pieces hangs from the ceiling, reflecting the bright indoor light.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 來釜山這些事必做!. [Subtitle]: 搭車欣賞海景. (2) [Subtitle]: 穿韓服拍照. (3) [Subtitle]: 體驗汗蒸幕. (4) [Logo]: VISIT BUSAN PASS. [Subtitle]: 這些門票釜山PASS裡都有包含! 玩下來超划算. (5) [Subtitle]: 景點會分成A,B兩區. (6) [Subtitle]: 限時型方案. 時效內所有景點都可以免費入場. 我這次是選這個方案!. (7) [Slogan]: - 海雲台海岸列車 -. [Subtitle]: 先搭乘海岸列車. 近距離的觀賞美麗海景. (8) [Slogan]: - X the SKY -. [Subtitle]: 再到韓國第二高樓的 LCT 地標塔. 由上往下俯瞰整片大海. 裡面還有可以看海的座位! 非常壯觀!. (9) [Slogan]: - 海雲台HAEON韓服 -. [Subtitle]: 韓服體驗絕對不能錯過. 海雲台這間韓服店, 大人及小孩都有很多款式可選擇. 光是店內佈置的場景, 就可以拍很久!. (10) [Slogan]: - Running Man 體驗館 -. [Subtitle]: 有帶小朋友同行的話, 也非常適合來這裡玩. 總共有四大區域, 裡面有各種關卡可以挑戰. 完成任務後可以得到R幣, 最後會計算分數, 可以拿小禮物!. (11) [Slogan]: - Spa Land -. [Subtitle]: 一整天玩下來, 晚上再來汗蒸幕放鬆!. 除了不同溫度的烤箱外, 還有付費按摩椅. 也有泡麵區跟販賣部, 可以買泡麵跟烤蛋來吃. 超多設施可以體驗的~ 舒服到不想回家. (12) [Subtitle]: 只要先在 KKday 上購買釜山PASS. 在現場出示 QRCode. 給店家掃描就 OK 了! 非常方便!. (13) [Slogan]: 留言 +1 索取詳細連結. [Subtitle]: 要去釜山玩的朋友快預訂起來!.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Diverse locations in Busan including the Haeundae coast, traditional interiors with folding screens, a bustling indoor game center, a modern high-rise observation deck, and a luxury traditional-style spa.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy, upbeat K-pop music begins immediately with a fast tempo. The track features bright, synthesized textures and a driving electronic beat with strong percussion and a heavy kick drum. (2) A female singer delivers vocals in Korean with a cheerful, high-pitched tone and clear articulation. The vocal melody is rhythmic and repetitive, fitting the high-arousal energy of the dance-pop track. (3) The background music continues without interruption, maintaining a consistent energetic vibe. A very subtle percussive sound of an egg hitting is almost completely masked by the dominant BGM mix. (4) The audio remains dominated by the BGM throughout the middle section of the video. There is no spoken narration, relying entirely on the music to establish the positive and fun atmosphere. (5) A brief digital 'ding' sound effect occurs as the QR code is scanned, acting as a clear UI feedback sound event. (6) The music maintains its intensity until the final seconds, where it concludes with a final rhythmic beat followed by a clean fade-out into silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Sequence of attractions -> Practical Tutorial -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote tourism in Busan, South Korea, specifically highlighting the 'Visit Busan Pass' as a cost-effective way to enjoy major attractions like the coastal train, Hanbok rentals, observation decks, and spas.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention and instruction on how to purchase the 'Visit Busan Pass' via 'KKday', including showing logos and pricing.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A fast-paced, high-energy travel guide utilizing a popular K-pop aesthetic and clear instructional overlays to encourage tourism and travel pass purchases.
